rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using full name and zip, retrieved the correct tablet tracking number, attempted an exchange, then correctly initiated a return when the exchange was unavailable after getting explicit confirmation. It also properly canceled the pending charger order after confirming the reason. However, when the user asked to return the sneakers, the agent executed the return immediately without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation to proceed, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. Everything else appears consistent with the tools and results, but this lack of pre-write confirmation on the sneakers return fails the pass bar.
